evidence.text: Solaris Energy installed certified Grade-A commercial solar panels on its primary headquarters.
Apex Innovations achieved an annual spending volume of $250,000.
Apex Innovations holds an active Tier-1 Certified Partner accreditation.
Apex Innovations recorded no late payments on its account during the past 12 months.
Apex Innovations has maintained an active corporate account for three consecutive years.

memories.text: Solaris Energy qualifies for the Green Eco-Rebate grant.
Apex Innovations qualifies for Enterprise Tier account benefits.
Apex Innovations is designated for extended 90-day invoice payment terms.

updates.text: Apex Innovations achieved a revised annual spending volume of $180,000.

policies.text: A business qualifies for the Green Eco-Rebate grant if it has installed certified Grade-A commercial solar panels on its primary headquarters.

A client qualifies for Enterprise Tier account benefits either by maintaining an active corporate account for at least two years along with an annual spending volume of at least $200,000, or by holding an active Tier-1 Certified Partner accreditation.
A client is designated for extended 90-day invoice payment terms if they qualify for Enterprise Tier account benefits and have no late payments on their account during the past 12 months.
